item.title: Cla☆Cra - CLASSY☆CRANBERRY'S
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: ωstar, Atelier Kaguya P-ch
  • 発売日: 2010-07-23
  • スコア: 7.42/10 (245 人評価)
  • 日本語名: クラ☆クラ CLASSY☆CRANBERRY’S
  • 英語名: Cla☆Cra - CLASSY☆CRANBERRY’S

别名

  • clacra

あらすじ

The protagonist, Honda Rei is the only son of the world-famous Honda zaibatsu.

While his genius scientist mother and his world renowned actor father are often busy abroad, he has his sister-in-law, an attractive college student, his childhood friend and best friend with him leading fun happy student lives. They attend a school for the ultra wealthy elite where the majority of the students are sons or daughters of financial heavyweights.
